pages.text:
E-COMMERCE PLATFORM MIGRATION SPECIFICATION
Document ID: DOC-PHX-ARCH-03
Author: Sarah Lin, Staff Platform Architect
1. Executive Summary
The legacy monolith (PHP/MySQL) is being decommissioned in favor of an event-driven Go and Node.js microservices architecture deployed to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). Core data persistence will transition to managed PostgreSQL with Citus distributed sharding.

3. Technical Decision Record: Database Migration Strategy
DECISION: We have chosen PostgreSQL 16 over DynamoDB and MongoDB.
RATIONALE: Relational consistency across order line items, strict ACID guarantees during payment transactions, and native JSONB capabilities for flexible product catalog facets.
STATUS: Migration tooling (Debezium + Kafka CDC pipeline) is completed for 80% of tables. Final cutover scheduled for November 12, 2026.

7. Authentication and Service Mesh Communication
DECISION: All inter-service gRPC communication will enforce mutual TLS (mTLS) through Istio sidecars.
DEPENDENCY: Service-to-service authorization depends strictly on the central user-service auth module emitting RS256 signed tokens.
BLOCKER: The auth module latency spikes under load (p99 > 340ms) when validating expired session tokens against Redis.

pages.text:
PAYMENT INTEGRATION ARCHITECTURE NOTES
Date: October 2, 2026
Owner: Sarah Lin
2. Payment Provider Selection & Conflicting Directive
In the August committee meeting, the platform team tentatively selected Stripe Elements for tokenization. However, on September 28, VP of Finance requested evaluation of Adyen due to European interchange rate savings.
CURRENT STATUS: Stripe sandbox integration is completed; Adyen contract is still pending legal review. Engineering MUST know if the dual-provider abstraction is required before the November freeze.

4. Critical Regulatory Risk: PCI-DSS Audit Deadline
RISK: Annual external PCI-DSS compliance audit commences on November 18, 2026.
IMPACT: HIGH / CRITICAL. If token storage vaulting is not fully decoupled from primary database replicas, audit failure will halt credit card processing across all storefronts.
OWNER: Payment Squad Lead (Unassigned pending Sarah Lin departure handover).

6. Incomplete Work and Outstanding Tasks
- Task 1: Complete Webhook idempotency handler for asynchronous payment failure notifications. (PENDING)
- Task 2: Implement automated fallback to secondary gateway in case of primary API 5xx outage. (PENDING - Needs approval)
- Task 3: Load test webhook processor with 10,000 req/sec batch payload.

pages.text:
PHOENIX REPLATFORMING: Q3 EXECUTIVE STATUS REPORT
Reporting Period: July 1 - September 30, 2026
Completed Milestones:
1. GKE multi-zone cluster provisioning with automated Terraform modules (COMPLETED - 100%).
2. Customer identity & OAuth2 token issuance service migrated from monolithic sessions (COMPLETED - 100%).
3. Product Catalog GraphQL microservice deployed to staging (COMPLETED - 100%).

5. Cross-Team Dependencies and Technical Blockers
DEPENDENCY: Real-time inventory sync is dependent on ERP SAP connector team delivering API v2 by October 30. (Status: Delayed by 2 weeks).
BLOCKER: Search indexing worker memory leak in Elasticsearch cluster causes OOM kills every 72 hours when indexing catalog diffs.

8. Unresolved Knowledge Gaps & Questions Before Sarah Leaves
QUESTION 1: Who holds the root credentials and PGP key for the encrypted database backup volume in S3/GCS?
QUESTION 2: What is the failover protocol if the primary Kafka broker partition leader crashes during the live DNS switchover?
QUESTION 3: Is the legacy coupon calculation engine documented anywhere, or does the new checkout rewrite simply discard unsupported promotion types?
